technical_tokens.caps_disposition: Uppercase tokens outside KEPT_ENGLISH are English emphasis (STALE, ONE, ONLY, NOT, FINAL, APPROVE, WORKSTREAM, ...). Chinese has no case and renders the emphasis lexically; their absence is recorded as emphasis_tokens_rendered_lexically, not as a dropped placeholder.
technical_tokens.note: Flags, backticks, angle tokens, ANSI escapes, URLs, paths and %-tokens are compared literally; kept-English identifiers are checked against the style-guide list; ALL-CAPS emphasis is not a placeholder.

width.note: Cells counted as 2 for East Asian W/F, 1 for ASCII, 0 for combining marks.

sample_review.method: stratified by English message length (<40, 40-80, 80-120, >120); >=15% of each stratum (min 1), ALL messages >120 chars, ALL plural messages
